'''Ein''' (Japanese: '''ボルグ''' ''Borg'') is one of the original four {{tc|Cipher Admin}}s. A cruel and callous young scientist, he is long on ambition and short on emotion. He is obsessed with the idea of creating an insanely powerful Pokémon at any cost which he managed to do with amazing results.

In battle, Ein prefers to use {{m|Rain Dance}}, then {{m|Thunder}}. He protects his {{type|Water}} and {{type|Flying}} Pokémon from {{type|Electric}} moves by often having a Pokémon with {{a|Lightningrod}} out on the field. He also likes using {{m|Toxic}} and {{m|Protect}} to dodge attacks while the poison damage increases each turn.

==In the games==
Ein is the brains behind the process that creates [[Shadow Pokémon]]. His research reports, the "[[Ein File]]s", can be found across [[Orre]] wherever members of Cipher have been present. He creates Shadow Pokémon in a secluded lab in the middle of a desert, and then has the Pokémon shipped to [[Venus]] and [[Miror B.]] via [[The Under Subway]]. He also does everything in his power to keep the Shadow Pokémon he creates from being [[Purification|purified]]. He tries to have [[Rui]] kidnapped, the [[Relic Stone]] destroyed, and the [[Time Flute]] stolen. Ultimately all these plans are foiled by the {{player}}.

Eventually the player confronts Ein at the [[Cipher Lab|Shadow PKMN Lab]]. Despite him possessing a Shadow version of the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{p|Raikou}}, Ein is still defeated. Even in defeat, Ein takes solace in that he has already created {{p|Tyranitar|the ultimate Shadow Pokémon}}, and had it transported to [[Evice|his boss]].

Ein appears again at the [[Realgam Tower]]. The mad scientist had one of the ID Badges to the tower's main entrance. After being defeated again, Ein hands over the [[Ylw ID Badge]] and promptly leaves the tower.

After Cipher has been defeated, Ein appears at the [[Deep Colosseum]], being the final opponent of the fourth round.

==In the manga==
[[File:Ein CSL.png|thumb|200px|Ein in Pokémon Colosseum Snatcher Leo]]
===Pokémon Colosseum Snatcher Leo===
Ein appeared in [[Pokémon Colosseum Snatcher Leo]] manga. He was shown to have a {{p|Starmie}}, {{p|Manectric}}, {{p|Crobat}}, {{p|Pelipper}}, and {{p|Rhydon}}.
{{-}}

==Trivia==
* Ein's name is derived from one of the greatest 20th-century scientists, {{wp|Albert Einstein}}.
* Ein bears a striking resemblance to [[Colress]], both in terms of appearance and motive. Both are scientists who wear glasses and a white lab coat and have a long, prominent hair flick. Furthermore, they both strive to unlock the potential in Pokémon, and side with the [[Cipher|villainous]] [[Team Plasma|team]] of their [[Pokémon Colosseum|respective]] {{game|Black and White|s|games|2}}.
